title: Check a qualified supervisor's certificate
summary: You can check a qualified supervisor's certificate or search for your own certificate details online.
intro:
You can check a qualified supervisor's certificate or search for your own certificate details online.

To check a qualified supervisor's digital certificate, refer to Check a digital trade licence or credential in the Service NSW app.
what_you_need: location (suburb, postcode or local government area)

how_to_steps.text: Enter the information you have into the search bar.
